scope: Public repository/source/official documentation research; no account operations, installations or target-device benchmarks.
version_policy: Dates are snapshots with explicit meanings. Do not upgrade by date alone. Lock tested dependencies and model licenses during implementation.

sources.name: baidu-drive-sdk-go
evidence: Download returns io.ReadCloser; this is not proof of Range, low-bitrate rendition or audio-only access.
OAuth and authorized directory access require current account verification.

sources.name: bdpan-storage
evidence: Application scope /apps/bdpan/ is not the user's /apps/教育分析学习/ permission.
Content extraction includes text and selected Office/PDF types, with async tasks, quotas, truncation and expiring result URLs; not general image/audio/archive parsing.
External SKILL was examined as source, not adopted or installed.

sources.name: qjfoidnh/BaiduPCS-Go
evidence: File operations, transfers and resumable download candidate; only normal authorized and platform-permitted use.
Do not use a CLI to bypass a current access denial.

sources.name: jing1312/baidu-ai-batch
evidence: Browser workflow for Baidu AI artifacts; file listing is current-directory/finite-page/video-oriented.
PPT click and short wait, DOM text length, or existing output file are insufficient completion tests.
Read-only artifact detection must be separated from any generation action.

sources.name: jing1312/skipping-lectures
evidence: Specialized orchestration for Xiangzhang and Baidu workflows; not a universal website or mixed-format ingestion engine.
Reuse the routing idea; keep module A/B boundaries and independent analysis.

sources.name: kola-official/baidu-transfer-helper
evidence: Recursive/paginated transfer and backoff reference.
Retry with newcopy, missing errno interpretation and absence of complete destination reconciliation require repairs.

sources.name: capwitf/baidu-netdisk-knowledge-mcp
evidence: PDF/DOCX are largely plain-text extraction; arrayBuffer/readFile load full data.
Heuristic first-character/first-line summaries are not general-model analysis.
Scope guard must be replaced with exact user-authorized root validation.

sources.name: OpenList
evidence: Multi-storage/WebDAV integration candidate; evaluate only officially authorized access modes.
Not needed as an additional always-running system for the first single-site closure.

sources.name: bypy
evidence: Maintenance-mode sync/download tool limited to /apps/bypy; incompatible with current scope.

sources.name: LiteParse
evidence: Local parsing without LLM/API; text coordinates, complexity analysis and visual assets/regions.
Office conversion and target operating-system dependencies need deployment check.

sources.name: Docling
evidence: Structured multimodal document conversion and provenance.
Pipeline settings and image export must be explicit; bitmap extraction alone misses vector graphics.

sources.name: MarkItDown
evidence: Markdown conversion of common document types is useful but not a full-fidelity evidence format.
Official OCR plugin can silently skip OCR when no llm_client is configured.

sources.name: MinerU
sources.license: Custom Apache-based LICENSE.md; not assumed unmodified Apache-2.0
evidence: Tiered native/CPU/advanced parsing; evaluate the required tier rather than assume all modes need a GPU.
Current document-library CLI and stateless parsing have differing page defaults; verify complete page set.
Version 4 and legacy integration compatibility need isolation.

sources.name: Unstructured
evidence: Document partitioning, image/table blocks and structured extraction.
Do not install a second full parsing stack without need; generated descriptions must not overwrite source tables.

sources.name: LlamaParse
evidence: MCP design exposes estimateFileComplexity, local LiteParse route and advanced parsing route.
Preserve coordinate transforms, image outputs, task receipts and credits; hosted processing is external data transfer.

sources.name: Azure Document Intelligence
evidence: Office/HTML embedded or linked images are not analyzed in the documented native path.
Free F0 can return only the first two pages; successful response is not complete coverage.

sources.name: Azure Content Understanding
evidence: Multimodal document/audio/video processing with modality units and generative-token costs.
Do not compare just one advertised price with whole pipeline cost.

sources.name: Google Document AI
evidence: Layout parsing of supported documents; format/version and processor limits apply.
Not a Baidu access connector.

sources.name: DocETL
evidence: LLM batch operations and resolve/cost controls suit structured understanding.
Not a downloader or OCR; automated optimization needs a bounded budget.

sources.name: RAG-Anything
evidence: Multimodal knowledge retrieval after collection; not proof all course evidence was read.
Current documented MinerU requirement is 3.x, not interchangeable with 4.x.

sources.name: LightRAG
evidence: Optional later cross-project retrieval/relations; graph construction still uses resources.
First-course comprehensive reading cannot be replaced with top-k retrieval only.

sources.name: NotebookLM / NotebookLM Enterprise
evidence: Notebook/source management APIs are documented; do not infer a complete automated question/report export API.
Optional reading/comparison endpoint, not acquisition identity or evidence authority.

sources.name: FFmpeg
sources.license: LGPL/GPL depending on components and build
evidence: Demux/decode and conversion tool; input stream capabilities remain source dependent.
Output -vn, local scaling or sparse frames do not by themselves reduce source network bytes.

sources.name: PyAV
evidence: Python media/frame access for bounded workers; application must enforce input/queue limits.

sources.name: faster-whisper
evidence: CTranslate2 and quantized inference; benchmarks are hardware/config specific.
decode_audio accumulates full PCM before float32 array; outer windowing is mandatory for long courses.

sources.name: SenseVoice / SenseVoiceSmall
sources.license: Code MIT; model card uses model-license, check full model terms
evidence: Chinese/Cantonese and other supported languages; direct inference duration and timestamp contracts are version sensitive.
Published A800 latency is not household-device whole-pipeline latency.

sources.name: sherpa-onnx
evidence: ONNX runtime integration with supported SenseVoice models; benchmark actual target CPU.

sources.name: Silero VAD
evidence: Local speech activity detection; VAD silence is not proof of no useful visual or quiet speech content.

sources.name: RapidOCR
evidence: Lightweight OCR candidate shared across document and video frames; preserve original images.

sources.name: PaddleOCR
evidence: Structure/formula/OCR upgrade route; do not load multiple large OCR models by default.

sources.name: PySceneDetect
evidence: Scene-change detectors; pair with local OCR/text changes, periodic sampling and semantic visual cues.

sources.name: Qwen3-ASR-Flash-Filetrans
evidence: Asynchronous file transcription and timestamp output; preserve task/usage status.
Current listed rates used for arithmetic: Beijing CNY 0.00022/second; Singapore CNY 0.00026/second. Excludes storage, networking, retries and LLM analysis.

sources.name: Gemini video understanding
evidence: Clip, frame-rate and resolution controls; temporal sampling may miss short actions.
Do not send all courses by default; private Baidu URLs are not automatically fetchable by an external service.

sources.name: Crawlee
evidence: Persistent request queues and resource-aware concurrency; storage and purge settings affect restart behavior.
Do not treat single-machine filesystem storage as a multi-process shared job ledger.

sources.name: Prefect
evidence: Self-hosted orchestration; infrastructure requirements vary with deployment scale.
Do not replace the existing business SQLite merely for a visual workflow.

sources.name: LangGraph
evidence: Checkpointer-based durable execution; in-memory saver does not survive process restart.
Keep project evidence ledger authoritative when adding framework execution state.

sources.name: n8n
sources.license: Sustainable Use License and other repository license components; not claimed OSI open source
evidence: Possible outer orchestration; large media bytes should not pass through every workflow node.
Check actual license and intended deployment before external commercial hosting.
